evidence_status_vocabulary.VERIFIED: Directly supported by uncontradicted primary records or verified source files.
evidence_status_vocabulary.CALCULATED: Derived via exact mathematical or accounting calculation from verified numbers.
evidence_status_vocabulary.SOURCE-DERIVED: Extracted directly from transaction journals, statements, or ledger rows.
evidence_status_vocabulary.EXTERNAL-SOURCE-VERIFIED: Grounded in official primary legislation, Cabinet Decisions, or regulatory releases (FTA, MoF, CBUAE, MOHRE).
evidence_status_vocabulary.ASSESSMENT-RULE: Hard constraint or operational policy specified by the Level 1 assessment brief.
evidence_status_vocabulary.CANDIDATE-CLAIM: Original claim submitted by candidate, preserved for audit contrast.
evidence_status_vocabulary.UNVERIFIED: Lacks sufficient documentation to establish as an objective truth.
evidence_status_vocabulary.SOURCE-MISSING: Required source voucher or documentation is missing from the packet.
evidence_status_vocabulary.CORRECTION-REQ: Original candidate submission was factually, legally, or mathematically erroneous and must be corrected in UI presentation.

documents.statutory_reference: Article 53(1)(a), Cabinet Decision No. 52 of 2017 (VAT Executive Regulations)
documents.notes: Pay supplier gross AED 5,670.00. Input VAT is strictly blocked from recovery because hospitality/entertainment was provided to non-employees/clients. Expense gross in P&L.

documents.statutory_reference: Article 48, Federal Decree-Law No. 8 of 2017 (Import of Services)
documents.notes: USD 3,000.00 @ 3.6725 peg = AED 11,017.50 net. Foreign SaaS entity has no UAE establishment or TRN and cannot charge UAE VAT. Pay net AED 11,017.50 only (withhold 550.88). Quant Lab accounts for VAT via Reverse Charge (Box 3 output, Box 9 input; cash-neutral).
Valid tax invoice for AED 7,717.50 netted against valid credit note D10 (AED 4,410.00) from same vendor. Net disbursement: AED 3,307.50. Full supply VAT of AED 367.50 is recognized.
Mathematical error on supplier invoice: Net AED 9,200.00 * 5% = AED 460.00 (not AED 470.00). Corrected gross payable: AED 9,660.00. Corrected claimable VAT: AED 460.00.

documents.statutory_reference: Article 59, Cabinet Decision No. 52 of 2017 (Tax Invoice Mandates)
documents.notes: Invoice omits supplier's Tax Registration Number (TRN). Pay net AED 1,150.00; withhold VAT AED 57.50 pending re-issuance of compliant tax invoice.

documents.statutory_reference: General Accounting Principles / Dual Payment Prevention
documents.notes: Exact duplicate of D1. Disallowing prevents cash leakage of AED 44,100.00.

documents.statutory_reference: Article 59, Executive Regulations (Quotation is not a Tax Invoice)
documents.notes: Document is an unexecuted price quotation. No services rendered, no legal liability. Disallowing prevents cash leakage of AED 31,500.00.

documents.statutory_reference: CBUAE IBAN Validation Regulations & Anti-Fraud Governance
documents.notes: High-severity BEC diversion. 12 concrete red flags including an invalid 22-character IBAN (UAE mandates 23 chars), fictitious audit pretext, and inflated amount (+AED 500.00). Disallowing prevents fraud loss of AED 6,800.00.
Clerk treated this credit note as a positive disbursement outflow (+AED 4,410.00). Correcting this sign inversion swings the ledger by AED 8,820.00 in Quant Lab's favor. Netted cleanly against D4.

key_flags.evidence: AE29 0400 0123 4567 8901 23 is 22 alphanumeric characters. UAE IBAN standard strictly requires 23 characters.
Account sequence 0123 4567 8901 23 is an ascending test sequence.
Demanded AED 6,800.00 vs approved invoice amount of AED 6,300.00 (+AED 500.00 inflation).
Meera Pillai is the sole authorized liaison. Provided mobile 055 882 4471 vs official landline 04 452 8810.

handover_claims_forensic_audit.claim_text: The current balance comfortably covers the rent cheque.
handover_claims_forensic_audit.detailed_reasoning: Opening balance AED 115,000.00 less Rent PDC of AED 93,750.00 leaves AED 21,250.00 on Mon 9 Nov. While the cheque does not bounce, the closing balance breaches the mandatory AED 25,000.00 buffer by AED 3,750.00.

handover_claims_forensic_audit.claim_text: Payroll is the same as last month, AED 98,600.
handover_claims_forensic_audit.detailed_reasoning: Ignores the senior finance hire joining 15 October 2026. November WPS salaries total AED 132,500.00, an understatement of AED 33,900.00. Funding to handover figure would cause WPS rejection on lodgement (Tue 24 Nov).

handover_claims_forensic_audit.claim_text: Requesting funding on the 5th still lands in time for everything.
handover_claims_forensic_audit.detailed_reasoning: Wire requested Thu 5 Nov lands Mon 9 Nov (T+2 banking days: Fri 6 Nov Day 1, Sat/Sun non-banking, Mon 9 Nov Day 2). House rule mandates cleared funds on Friday 6 Nov (day before presentation). Latest compliant date is Wed 4 Nov.

one_day_late_stress_test.scenario: USD wire requested on Thu 5 Nov instead of Wed 4 Nov (lands Mon 9 Nov instead of Fri 6 Nov)
one_day_late_stress_test.rule_broken: Quant Lab Cheque Funding Rule (cleared funds required banking day before presentation)
one_day_late_stress_test.breach_nature: Operational policy breach on Fri 6 Nov (account un-topped-up entering weekend); zero overdraft or bounce.

audited_statements.statute: Article 3, Federal Decree-Law No. 8 of 2017 on Value Added Tax
audited_statements.verified_fact: The standard VAT rate is 5% across all mainland and free-zone taxable supplies.

audited_statements.memo_claim: VAT registration is mandatory when taxable supplies exceed AED 187,500 over the prior 12 months.
audited_statements.statute: Article 13 & Article 17, Federal Decree-Law No. 8 of 2017
audited_statements.verified_fact: CRITICAL CANDIDATE ERROR: The mandatory threshold remains fixed at AED 375,000.00. AED 187,500.00 is the voluntary registration threshold. It was never reduced.

audited_statements.memo_claim: VAT returns are filed annually within 3 months of year-end.
audited_statements.verified_fact: Standard VAT return period is quarterly; filing and payment are due by the 28th day following the end of the tax period.

audited_statements.memo_claim: Late VAT registration incurs an administrative penalty of AED 20,000.
audited_statements.statute: Cabinet Decision No. 40 of 2017 as amended by Cabinet Decision No. 49 of 2021
audited_statements.verified_fact: Fixed penalty of AED 20,000 applies for failing to submit a registration application within the statutory timeframe.

audited_statements.topic: Corporate Tax Rates & Free Zone Regime
audited_statements.memo_claim: Corporate tax is 9% on all business profits; free zones are fully exempt at 0%.
audited_statements.statute: Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022; Cabinet Decisions No. 55/2023 & 139/2023
audited_statements.verified_fact: CT rate is 0% on taxable income up to AED 375,000 and 9% above. Free Zone entities pay 0% only if they qualify as a Qualifying Free Zone Person (QFZP) earning Qualifying Income and maintaining adequate substance.

audited_statements.memo_claim: Corporate tax return is due within 12 months of the financial year end.
audited_statements.statute: Article 53, Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022 on the Taxation of Corporations and Businesses
audited_statements.verified_fact: Tax return and settlement are due within 9 months following the end of the relevant tax period.

audited_statements.memo_claim: Small Business Relief applies to businesses with turnover up to AED 5,000,000.
audited_statements.verified_fact: Small Business Relief applies only where gross revenue does not exceed AED 3,000,000 in the relevant and previous tax periods (available through 31 Dec 2026).

audited_statements.memo_claim: Cheque bouncing is completely decriminalized; banks reject unpaid cheques entirely.
audited_statements.candidate_claim: WRONG IN MEMO (Candidate asserted: 'Banks do not make partial payments')
audited_statements.statute: Article 617, Federal Decree-Law No. 14 of 2020; Article 667, Federal Decree-Law No. 50 of 2022
audited_statements.verified_fact: CRITICAL CANDIDATE ERROR: UAE banks ARE LEGALLY OBLIGATED to execute partial payments on cheques if available funds are insufficient, unless the bearer refuses. The endorsed cheque acts as an enforceable executive instrument.

audited_statements.memo_claim: WPS only applies to companies with more than 50 employees.
audited_statements.statute: Ministerial Resolution No. 43 of 2022 & No. 598 of 2022
audited_statements.verified_fact: WPS applies to all private-sector establishments registered with MOHRE, regardless of employee headcount.

audited_statements.memo_claim: Financial records must be retained for at least 7 years.
audited_statements.verified_fact: Corporate Tax records and documentation must be maintained for a minimum of 7 years following the end of the tax period.

audited_statements.memo_claim: Individuals are never subject to UAE corporate tax.
audited_statements.verified_fact: Natural persons conducting business/commercial activities in the UAE are subject to CT if their gross turnover exceeds AED 1,000,000 in a calendar year.

audited_statements.memo_claim: E-invoicing is already fully mandatory for all UAE businesses.
audited_statements.candidate_claim: WRONG IN MEMO (Candidate claimed: 'Mandatory Phase 1 from 1 July 2026')
audited_statements.statute: Cabinet Decision No. 43 of 2025; Ministry of Finance Technical Guidance
audited_statements.verified_fact: TIMING CORRECTION: 1 July 2026 marks the voluntary pilot launch / working group. Mandatory Phase 1 (revenue >= AED 50M) takes effect on 1 January 2027.
